# codethatidea

> > codethatidea offers coding and AI education for kids in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with personalized and group courses in Scratch and Python.

codethatidea is a coding education platform specializing in computer science curriculum for children, featuring both in-person classes in Amsterdam and online 1:1 instruction. The organization emphasizes machine learning and artificial intelligence literacy alongside foundational programming skills.

## Key Topics

- Coding for Kids
- Python Programming
- Scratch Programming
- Machine Learning Education
- Artificial Intelligence
- Generative AI
- Amsterdam Classes
- Online Learning
- Computer Science Curriculum
- 1:1 Tutoring
- CSTA Standards
- Youth Education
- Personalized Learning
- Group Courses
- Educational Institutions

## Core Programs

- [1:1 Online Live Coding Classes](https://www.codethatidea.com/1-1-coding-classes): Personalized 1:1 online coding classes with ML and AI curriculum
- [Coding & AI Courses for Kids in Amsterdam](https://www.codethatidea.com/coding-and-ai-courses-for-kids-amsterdam): Group coding and AI courses in Scratch and Python for kids in Amsterdam
- [For Childcare Facility](https://www.codethatidea.com/for-childcare-facility): Structured coding courses designed for childcare and educational institutions
